
==  Proposed Definitions And Examples ==

===  Proposed Definition of ''ri'a'' ===

;'''ri'a''' (BAI):  With cause... Tags a sumti as fitting the 1st place of rinka.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 1st place of rinka and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi is caused by the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: rinka, ja'e, ni'i, mu'i, ki'u, se ri'a, te ri'a, ri'a ma, ri'a nai, se ri'a nai.

** Keywords: With cause

===  Examples of ''ri'a'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i le bolci cu farlu ri'a lo nu mi co'u sarji ri''

The ball fell because I stopped holding it up.

===  Proposed Definition of ''ri'a ma'' ===

;'''ri'a ma''' (BAI*):  With what cause? Tags a sumti question marker as fitting the first place of rinka.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the first place of rinka and then fills it with a sumti question cmavo (ma).  In other words, the tagged sumti asks what physically caused the event described by the bridi.  See also: rinka, ja'e, ni'i, mu'i, ki'u, ri'a, se ri'a, te ri'a, ri'a nai, se ri'a nai.

** Keywords: With what cause?

===  Examples of ''ri'a ma'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i ri'a ma le tsani cu blanu''

Why is the sky blue?

===  Proposed Definition of ''ri'a nai'' ===

;'''ri'a nai''' (BAI*):  Not caused by... Tags a sumti as not fitting the 1st place of rinka. Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 1st place of na'e rinka and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi is not caused by the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: rinka, ja'e, ni'i, mu'i, ki'u, ri'a, se ri'a, te ri'a, ri'a ma, se ri'a nai.

** Keywords: Not caused by, regardles of cause.

===  Examples of ''ri'a nai'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i mi nelci do ri'anai lo za'i do melbi''

I like you, but not because you're beautiful.

===  Note ===

It should be noted (and this applies to all BAI+nai) constructs that while the above example asserts that "mi nelci do", and it asserts that this isn't a result of "do melbi", it does *not* assert "do melbi" one way or the other.

===  Proposed Definition of ''se ri'a'' ===

;'''se ri'a''' (BAI*):  With result... Tags a sumti as fitting the 2nd place of rinka.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 2nd place of rinka and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi is the cause of the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: rinka, ja'e, mu'i, ni'i, ki'u, ri'a, te ri'a, ri'a ma, ri'a nai, se ri'a nai.

** Keywords: With result

===  Examples of ''se ri'a'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i do darxi mi seri'a lo za'i mi cortu''

You hit me, which results in my pain.

===  Proposed Definition of ''se ri'a nai'' ===

;'''se ri'a nai''' (BAI*):  Not resulting in... Tags a sumti as not fitting the 2nd place of rinka. Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 2nd place of na'e rinka and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi does not cause the event described by the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: rinka, ja'e, mu'i, ni'i, ki'u, ri'a, se ri'a, te ri'a, ri'a ma, ri'a nai.

** Keywords: Not resulting in

===  Examples of ''se ri'a nai'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i do darxi le ve tivni seri'anai lonu ri se cikre''

You hit the TV, but that doesn't result in it being repaired.

===  Proposed Definition of ''te ri'a'' ===

;'''te ri'a''' (BAI*):  Caused under conditions... Tags a sumti as fitting the 3rd place of rinka.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 3rd place of rinka and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi is caused under the conditions described by the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: rinka, ja'e, mu'i, ni'i, ki'u, ri'a, se ri'a, ri'a ma, ri'a nai, se ri'a nai.

** Keywords: Caused under conditions...

===  Examples of ''te ri'a'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i le karce cu xe klama teri'a loza'i mi bilga lonu klama le zarci''

When I have to go to the store, the car is a vehicle.

===  Proposed Definition of ''ni'i'' ===

;'''ni'i''' (BAI):  By logic... Tags a sumti as fitting the 1st place of nibli.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 1st place of nibli and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi follows logically from the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: nibli, ja'e, mu'i, ri'a, ki'u, se ni'i, te ni'i, ni'i ma, ni'i nai, se ni'i nai.

** Keywords: By logic...

===  Examples of ''ni'i'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i la platon mrobi'o ni'i le du'u py remna''

Plato dies, which follows logically because he is human.

===  Proposed Definition of ''ni'i ma'' ===

;'''ni'i ma''' (BAI*):  By what logic? Tags a sumti question marker as fitting the first place of nibli.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the first place of nibli and then fills it with a sumti question cmavo (ma).  In other words, the tagged sumti asks by what logic the event described by the bridi occurs.  See also: nibli, ja'e, ri'a, mu'i, ki'u, ni'i, se ni'i, te ni'i, ni'i nai, se ni'i nai.

** Keywords: By what logic?

===  Examples of ''ni'i ma'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''do krici lo du'u gendra ni'i ma''

"You believe that is grammatical by what logic?"

===  Proposed Definition of ''ni'i nai'' ===

;'''ni'i nai''' (BAI*):  Does not logically follow from... Tags a sumti as not fitting the 1st place of nibli. Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 1st place of nibli and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi does not logically follow from the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: nibli, ja'e, ri'a, mu'i, ki'u, ni'i, se ni'i, te ni'i, ni'i ma, se ni'i nai.

** Keywords: Does not logically follow from..., regardless of logical cause.

===  Examples of ''ni'i nai'' Usage ===

Artificial:

''.i do bilga lonu pilno lo palku kei ni'inai loza'i do nanmu''

Your being obliged to wear pants doesn't logically follow from the state of your being a man.

===  Proposed Definition of ''se ni'i'' ===

;'''se ni'i''' (BAI*):  Logically therefore... Tags a sumti as fitting the 2nd place of nibli.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 2nd place of nibli and then fills it with the tagged sumti. In other words, the event described by the bridi logically leads to the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: nibli, ja'e, mu'i, ri'a, ki'u, ni'i, te ni'i, ni'i ma, ni'i nai, se ni'i nai.

** Keywords: Logically therefore...

===  Examples of ''se ni'i'' Usage ===

''.i se ni'i ri cusku no da poi lojbo''

Because of that, nothing lojbanic is expressed.

===  Proposed Definition of ''se ni'i nai'' ===

;'''se ni'i nai''' (BAI*):  Does not logically entail... Tags a sumti as not fitting the 2nd place of nibli. Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 2nd place of nibli and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi does not logically entail the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: nibli, ja'e, ri'a, mu'i, ki'u, ni'i, se ni'i, te ni'i, ni'i ma, ni'i nai.

** Keywords: Does not logically entail...

===  Examples of ''se ni'i nai'' Usage ===

''lo gerku lo plini cu simsa le ka barda .i se ni'i nai bo ri xi re ri xi ci simsa le ka barda''

Dogs are similar to planets in size; it does not therefore follow that planets are similar to dogs in size.

(I don't actually have any idea what this person was talking about, but this is a real usage, very slightly modified.)

===  Proposed Definition of ''te ni'i'' ===

;'''te ni'i''' (BAI*):  Under logic system... Tags a sumti as fitting the 3rd place of nibli. Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 3rd place of nibli and then fills it with the tagged sumti. In other words, the event described by the bridi occurs under the logic system described by the referent of the tagged sumti.  See also: nibli, ja'e, mu'i, ri'a, ki'u, ni'i, se ni'i, ni'i ma, ni'i nai, se ni'i nai.

==  Notes ==

==  Impact ==

There exists a contradiction between the CLL and the ma'oste about the meaning of BAInai WRT causals. The interpretation we are using (explicated in the preface section) here for "ri'a nai" and such matches with that found in the CLL (Chapter 9, Section 13). To get the meaning shown in the ma'oste (despite...), it is suggested to use e.g. to'eri'anai instead of ri'anai.

This is shown as the following:

* ri'a == with cause
* ri'anai == not with cause (regardless of cause)

* to'eri'a == prevented by 
* to'eri'anai == not prevented by (despite)
